text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaaah!!
I completely missed the start!! To think I overslept...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“If you've got time to whine, hurry up!
All the good spots are gonna be taken!”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I gotta see your journey through to the end.
—As your rival.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘How far will Almond Eye's winning streak go...!’
‘Can't wait~!’ ‘Ai-chan plushie—’
‘Ai is the strongest!’ ‘She's definitely gonna win!!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Just how strong is Almond Eye, seriously?
Could she actually stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Rudolf and the likes—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa!?
S-Symboli Rudolf...!"

On the day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
the venue was filled with tremendous excitement and anticipation.
—To the extent that it reached all the way to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on,
calm down!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You can just hold your head high
and wait for me!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If you do that...
I will make your dream come true."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Winning lots of races—that's both my dream and yours.
I'll make both come true.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âWatch me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's too early to get sentimental! Come on, give me a push!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to take that step forward
with your 'have a good race'!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âI'm off!
(Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hyped!
Looks like everyone was looking forward to today, too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
...My heart is racing too.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! There she is!!
Almond Eyeeeeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...!
This is...—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You can feel the buzz, right?!
EVERYONE was waiting for Ai!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, Boo's got fans too♪
Thank youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Ai is gonna do
something super amazing today, right?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That's right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll win,
and make our dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Ai just keeps getting stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Still! Buu's not gonna lose either!
Let's do this, Ai!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Ai.
I... still haven't sorted out my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I have no more doubts.
...I will defeat you, and—”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll steal all this massive cheering for myself! Starting today—I'm the main character!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how lovely!
Your eyes are sparkling too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to be welcomed...
with an even more wonderful sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —The one who will win is me!
